slides.title: prompts to turn AI into your trading coach
slides.sub: A plan, a journal analyst, a tilt check, a backtest designer, a weekly review.
slides.voiceover: Most traders lose because they never review a single trade.

slides.name: The Trade Plan
slides.prompt: Act as a trading coach. Help me write my trading plan for [MARKET] on the [TIMEFRAME] chart: which setups I take, entry and exit rules, max risk per trade, max trades per day, and the conditions where I **DON'T TRADE** at all.
slides.tip: Write it down before your next session. Rules you can see beat rules you remember.
slides.voiceover: First, it writes your trading plan: your setups, your limits, your no-trade zone.

slides.name: The Position Sizer
slides.sub: Never risk more than you planned
slides.prompt: My account is [$ACCOUNT], I risk [RISK]% per trade. Entry [PRICE], stop loss [STOP], target [TARGET]. Calculate position size, the money at risk, the reward-to-risk ratio, and tell me if this trade **FITS MY RULES**: [RULES].
slides.voiceover: Then it sizes the position so one bad trade never wrecks your account.

slides.name: The Journal Analyst
slides.sub: Find the pattern in your losses
slides.prompt: Here is my trade journal from the last month: [PASTE TRADES WITH DATE, SETUP, ENTRY, EXIT, RESULT, NOTES]. Find my win rate per setup, time of day, and emotion tag, and name the **ONE HABIT** that costs me the most.
slides.tip: Paste even 10 trades. The pattern shows up faster than you'd think.
slides.voiceover: This one reads your journal and names the one habit costing you the most.

slides.name: The Post-Mortem
slides.prompt: Review this losing trade like a strict coach: [DESCRIBE TRADE AND WHAT I WAS THINKING]. Was it a bad trade or a good trade that lost? Which rule did I break, what did I ignore, and what is the **LESSON** in one sentence?
slides.tip: Do this right after the loss, while it's still fresh.
slides.voiceover: It breaks down your worst trade and gives you the lesson in one line.

slides.name: The Tilt Check
slides.prompt: Before each session, ask me 6 short questions about sleep, mood, recent losses and why I want to trade today. Based on my answers, tell me to trade normally, reduce size, or **SKIP THE DAY**, and explain why.
slides.tip: Answer honestly. It only works if you don't lie to it.
slides.voiceover: Before you open the app, it checks if you should even be trading today.

slides.name: The Backtest Designer
slides.sub: Test the idea before real money
slides.prompt: I have a trading idea: [DESCRIBE STRATEGY]. Turn it into exact, testable rules, design a manual backtest on [NUMBER] past examples, the numbers to record for each, and the results that would make me **DROP THE IDEA**.
slides.tip: Test it on paper first. Real money comes after, not before.
slides.voiceover: This one turns a vague idea into exact rules you can test on paper first.

slides.name: The Weekly Review
slides.prompt: Here's my week: [TRADES, P/L, RULE BREAKS, NOTES]. Write my weekly review: what went well, what went wrong, whether I followed my plan (score 1-10), and **ONE FOCUS** for next week with a way to measure it.
slides.tip: Same day, same time, every week. Consistency is the whole point.
slides.voiceover: And every week, it scores your discipline and picks your one focus.
